text: Main research direction 1. Theory and technology of precise guidance, navigation and control of moving body 2. Research on space exploration and in-orbit technology of aircraft 3. Information interaction and processing technology integrating heaven and earth 4. Application of intelligent control and active control technology in aircraft design 5. Onboard (onboard) computer, embedded system and embedded application software 6. Research on the application of virtual reality technology in space simulation 7. Underwater acoustic countermeasures and guidance and control of underwater vehicles Duration 3 years
